title: Scrap and Shrapnel Grenade
summary: Throw for 1 Piercing and one turn of Bleeding in a wide area.

fields.Throw: Action, 60 ft range, 13 ft radius. Deals 1 Piercing and applies Bleeding for 1 turn.
fields.Bleeding: 2 Slashing at turn start, Disadvantage on Constitution saves, ends on healing. Constructs, elementals, plants, oozes and most undead are immune.
fields.Acquisition: Western Beach boat, Glynda Oltower or certain NPCs.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
